title: customer-success
text:
customer-success

Maria (CS): Quick sync — we need coverage for the Hypercare workshop next week across APAC / EMEA / NA. Three customers: NovaHealth (onboarding), Kitemed (dedicated migration), Lumina (renewal-watch). Prefer 2 facilitators per slot + one engineering floater. Who can cover which windows?
Raj (Solutions): I can take EMEA slot Tue 13:00-14:30 UTC. Will bring the migration checklist for Kitemed.
Liam (Enablement): Happy to run APAC late slot Wed 22:00-23:30 UTC. I have the hands-on lab prepared and the new quantization notes. Link: https://confluence.redwood/enablement/hypercare-labs
Olivia (Support): I can do NA Mon 09:00-10:30 UTC but I need a second facilitator for customer-specific API walkthroughs. Also FYI Lumina is marked as "renewal risk" in the health deck — they asked for SLA and private deployment clarifications.
Ben (Platform): I can float Wed APAC as engineering backup for perf questions. If load testing looks flaky I can hop in. :thumbsup:
Maria (CS): Perfect. Can we lock that? Also we should capture a short agenda and a feedback form link to send before each session.
Liam (Enablement): Draft agenda (short):
```
- 0:00 Welcome + intros
- 0:05 Customer goals and current blockers
- 0:20 Guided migration/demo (hands-on)
- 0:50 Q&A and next steps + action items
```
Maria (CS): I'll make the feedback form (2 quick questions + NPS). Will share calendar invites once slots confirmed.
Olivia (Support): For Lumina specifically can we add a 15min pre-call to align on security/KMS questions? They flagged HSM earlier.
Raj (Solutions): Yes, add pre-call Tue 12:30 UTC with me + Olivia. I'll prep a short doc on KMS mappings.
Maria (CS): Updated roster:
- Mon 09:00-10:30 UTC (NA) — Maria + Olivia
- Tue 13:00-14:30 UTC (EMEA) — Raj + Maria
- Wed 22:00-23:30 UTC (APAC) — Liam + Ben (floater)
OnboardBot: Calendar invites created and sent to participants and customers.
Liam (Enablement): Can someone add a note in the customer ticket about Lumina renewal risk and the pre-call? I can focus on APAC materials.
Olivia (Support): I'll update the ticket and tag @account-team.
Ben (Platform): Quick ops ask — for the hands-on lab we should publish a slim docker image to speed up setup. I'll push build by EOD.
Maria (CS): Action items:
- Maria: send invites + feedback form link (today)
- Raj: prep KMS doc + join pre-call (Tue 12:30 UTC)
- Olivia: update tickets and own Lumina pre-call
- Liam: finalize APAC lab + share lab link
- Ben: publish slim docker image for lab
Everyone: please add any customer-specific asks to the calendar event notes.
Raj (Solutions): Got it — will add Kitemed migration checklist to event.
Olivia (Support): :thumbsup: sounds good.
Maria (CS): If nothing else, I'll lock these and send invites in the next hour. Thanks all!"
